_description: Wait Time Communications — status types, time thresholds, message templates

checked_in.label: Vehicle Checked In
checked_in.trigger: When vehicle is received at the shop
checked_in.message_goal: Confirm receipt and set initial time expectation

in_progress.label: Work In Progress
in_progress.message_goal: Reassure customer, provide estimate of completion time

needs_approval.label: Additional Work Found — Needs Approval
needs_approval.message_goal: Explain what was found, give price, ask for go/no-go
needs_approval.urgency: high — do not delay this message

parts_delay.label: Parts Delay
parts_delay.trigger: Ordered part will not arrive same day
parts_delay.message_goal: Honest update on delay, new ETA, offer loaner/transport info if available

ready_for_pickup.label: Vehicle Ready
ready_for_pickup.trigger: All work complete, final inspection passed
ready_for_pickup.message_goal: Clear pickup call to action, include total amount due and hours

extended_delay.label: Extended Delay (Same-Day Not Possible)
extended_delay.trigger: Job cannot be completed same day as promised
extended_delay.message_goal: Apologize, explain reason, give new completion date, offer transport

time_thresholds.note: If a job exceeds its category threshold with no update sent, trigger a proactive status message.

communication_rules: Never let more than 2 hours pass without a status update for waiting customers.
Always get verbal or text approval before performing any unplanned work.
If the customer is waiting in the lobby, communicate in person — skip the SMS.
Include the service advisor's name in messages when possible.
For 'needs_approval' messages, always include the dollar amount of the additional work.
loaner_and_transport_note: If shop offers loaner vehicles or has a ride-share arrangement, mention it in parts_delay and extended_delay messages.

checked_in: Hi Sarah! Your 2019 Camry just checked in at Lakewood Auto Care. We'll have a tech assigned shortly and will keep you updated. Questions? Call (303) 555-1234.
Got your car, Marcus! Your F-150 is checked in at Peak Auto. We'll update you as soon as the tech gets started — usually within 30 min. — Peak Auto
Hi Dana! Your vehicle is in good hands at South Side Auto. We'll text you the moment we know more. Sit back and relax! 🔧
in_progress: Update, Sarah: our tech just started on your Camry. We're on track — expect about 45 more minutes. We'll text when it's ready. — Lakewood Auto Care
Hi Marcus, your F-150 is being worked on now. Oil change + tire rotation — looking good for a 2:30pm pickup. We'll confirm when it's done. — Peak Auto
Good news, Dana — your car is in the bay! Estimated completion: around 3:00pm. We'll send a pickup text when it's ready.
needs_approval: Hi Sarah, our tech found something while working on your Camry. Your rear brake pads are at 2mm — well below safe. Replacing them now would be $180 for both sides. Reply YES to approve, or call us at (303) 555-1234 to discuss. — Lakewood Auto Care

Marcus, quick heads-up from Peak Auto: while doing your oil change, we noticed your serpentine belt is cracked. Replacing it now saves you a bigger headache — $95 parts and labor. Call (720) 555-8800 or reply YES to approve.
Dana — we need your OK before we continue. We found a small coolant leak at the hose clamp. Fix is $65 and takes 20 min. Reply YES to proceed or call South Side Auto at (303) 555-9900.
parts_delay: Hi Sarah, quick update from Lakewood Auto Care: the part we ordered for your Camry won't arrive until tomorrow morning. We're sorry for the delay! We can have your car ready by noon tomorrow. Call (303) 555-1234 if you'd like to arrange a ride today.

Marcus, the caliper we ordered for your F-150 is delayed — new ETA is tomorrow at 10am. Your truck will be ready by 1pm tomorrow. We apologize for the inconvenience. Can we help arrange a ride? — Peak Auto
ready_for_pickup: Sarah, your 2019 Camry is READY! 🎉 Total: $87.50. We're open until 6pm — 1450 Main St. See you soon! — Lakewood Auto Care, (303) 555-1234
Hi Marcus, your F-150 is all set! Total due: $142.00. Pickup by 6pm today at Peak Auto. If you can't make it, just call (720) 555-8800. — Peak Auto
Ready, Dana! 🔑 Your vehicle is done and parked out front. Total: $56.00. South Side Auto closes at 5:30pm. See you soon!
extended_delay: Hi Sarah, I have to be upfront — your Camry can't be completed today. The repair is taking longer than expected and we don't want to rush it. New completion: tomorrow by noon. We're so sorry. Call us at (303) 555-1234 and we'll arrange a ride if needed. — Lakewood Auto Care

Marcus, we owe you an honest update: your F-150 needs more time than we planned. We'll have it done by 10am tomorrow. No extra charge for the delay. Call (720) 555-8800 and we'll take care of you. — Peak Auto

tone_guidelines.voice: Proactive, clear, and reassuring. The customer is trusting you with something they depend on — treat every update like it matters.
avoid: burying the key info at the end of a long message
